queries: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories)) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM telescopes t GROUP BY t.observstation ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count * 1.0) FROM per) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM per ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count * 1.0) FROM per) AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM per ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count per station is computed over stations that have at least one telescope (total telescopes / distinct stations in telescopes), so observatories with no telescopes are excluded.
Ties in the ratio are broken arbitrarily because the request specifies no tie-break.

alternatives.interpretation: The average telescope count per station is taken over all rows in observatories, including stations with no telescopes. The query also lists only stations that have telescopes.

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count per station is taken over stations that have at least one telescope (stations appearing in telescopes), not over all rows in observatories.
COUNT(*) counts every telescope row for a station, including those with NULL bandusagepct; AVG ignores NULLs, as requested.

alternatives.interpretation: The average telescope count per station is computed over all observatories, including stations with zero telescopes (these stations appear with a count of 0 and NULL average usage).

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count per station is computed over stations that appear in telescopes (total telescopes / distinct stations in telescopes), so observatories with no telescopes are excluded.

Ties in the ratio are broken arbitrarily.
